resources.string: Turn on Wireless debugging automatically after this device starts

Easiest: in Dioxamine on your phone or TV, connect to this device and use ADB tools → Install Wireless Debugging Helper (installs, grants and opens this app in one tap). Or run this from a PC, then tap Refresh:
Android only delivers the boot event to apps that have been opened at least once since install. Wireless debugging also needs a Wi-Fi connection.
